title: Match the coherent receiver linear error exponent without claiming photon superiority
statement: For R<=Rmax,|z|<=rmax<1,C=Rmax rmax+rmax^2/2>0 and raw-error budget0<delta<=C,a zero source and a passive source with ||G||=delta/C share an admissible transcript. Every Gram estimator has worst-case error>=delta/(2C);deterministic control in n>=2 can suffer regret delta/C.

requires: Fixed bounded reference amplitude and absolute bounded-error detector oracle
Unit/subunit commands and passive target loads
provides: Linear worst-case bounded-error exponent at fixed reference,up to constants/dimension
assumptions: Original intensity-only square-root theorem keeps its original information contract
No randomized-control lower bound is claimed here
costs: Charge all raw powers,reference/signal photons,combiner loss,calibration,mask writes,load switching,settling and reset;no free parameter,clock or arbitrarily strong local oscillator.
contract.units: Dimensionless power per incident feed-power unit;field amplitude is its square root. r,z,s are complex reflection amplitudes;R is reference amplitude. Physical photon/time calibration remains an acquired input.
contract.obstruction: An improved absolute-error modulus alone does not establish photon,device or universal optimizer advantage.
